data.name: DROD RPG: Tendry's Tale
data.detailed_description:
DROD RPG: Tendry's Tale is a 2D puzzle dungeon crawl with RPG, move optimization and resource management elements.

DROD RPG combines DROD's puzzle elements, strategy, world and story backdrop with player stats, weapons and armor, one-on-one monster duels, items, custom power-ups and treasure. It was inspired by the classic Tower of the Sorcerer and is similar in flavor to Desktop Dungeons.

As a puzzle/logic game, level layouts, items, enemy encounters, and treasures are all hand-crafted to bring you a series of engaging, well thought-out puzzles that are a joy to solve. Navigate through series of interlocking rooms, looking for the exit on each level. Spend hit points and resources wisely to power up and advance. Decide which pre-placed monsters to fight along the way. Battles resolve deterministically according to a clear set of rules. Get rewards from defeating enemies now or come back later when you're more powerful and can take less damage (hint: this is typically the better option).

Combining DROD's straight-forward interface and flexible puzzle widgets with the staples of dungeon crawling and resource management makes for a unique, genre-busting gaming experience. Play this game to relax and contemplate, or take advantage of its huge depth and optional elements of challenge and replayability to optimize your score against other Steam players. Along with a powerful level editor, modding capabilities and an enthusiastic player community producing novel puzzle content, this is a game you can enjoy for years.

The story

Help Tendry, a member of the scattered Stalwart Army, escape from entrapment far beneath the surface. He might not be the ideal warrior, but he's got a lot of panache to make up for his lack in prowess. Or at least he's always good for a laugh. Keep him from killing himself in battle long enough to save his homeland of Tueno from the menacing Underground Empire.

Key features

  • Upgraded version with Steam achievements, leaderboards and auto cloud-sync.
  • 13 interlocking puzzle levels of interconnected rooms, filled with monsters, treasure, traps, secrets, and surprises.
  • 25 custom swords, shields and special items to discover, each with unique capabilities.
  • Dozens of monster types and boss enemies with varying abilities and behavior.
  • Many other game elements based on DROD's singular logic puzzle experience.
  • Powerful campaign editor. Dozens of high-quality free usermade levels available to play!
  • Active, friendly player community on the Caravel Forum.

Deluxe edition

Contains both DROD RPG and the OST.

data.short_description: A puzzle dungeon-crawler based on DROD, inspired by Tower of the Sorcerer and similar in flavor to Desktop Dungeons. Help Tendry the Stalwart navigate interlocking room puzzles while optimizing player stats, balancing weapons and armor, acquiring loads of loot, and dueling monsters with wit and flair.

reviews.review:
The DROD (Deadly Rooms of Death) series, a hidden gem long revered by discerning puzzle connoisseurs, finally makes its Steam debut with DROD RPG: Tendry's Tale, complete with Steam Cloud, Achievements and Leaderboards!

DROD RPG is quite different from the main DROD series, which will also appear on Steam (hopefully) very soon. DROD first appeared in 1996 and has been kept up, reworked, and extended by just a few talented, dedicated developers and an active player/modder community.

(NOTE: when I refer to DROD RPG as opposed to Tendry's Tale, I refer to the engine and imply the possibility of there being further official DROD RPG titles)

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
While there are many similarities, the core gameplay mechanic in DROD is solving individual "rooms", while DROD RPG is about optimizing choices throughout an entire run through the game. Both games are laid out as a set of floors consisting of interconnected rooms. Floors are connected by stairs. Generally it's possible to backtrack just about anywhere at any point in (each half of) the game.

Tendry's Tale has about 400 rooms total, including 40 secret ones. The game is split into two halves with independent stats/progression.

DROD RPG, like DROD is a turn-based game. The basic movement commands are the same as DROD - 8 directional movement, and sword rotation. DROD RPG borrows mechanics from the main series such as door orbs, trapdoors, and bombs. Many of the enemies and characters will also be familiar.

Unlike DROD, DROD RPG has stats: HP, ATK, DEF, GR (gold), and items - weapons, shields, usable accessories, and keys. Unlike DROD, enemies do not move in DROD RPG. Instead of combat being purely a question of who strikes first, combat plays out based on stats (yours and your enemy).

Thus, the optimization gameplay is making decisions about when to and when not to fight, use keys, pick up items and stat boosting powerups, and determining a good order to do these actions in (e.g. pick up power ups before engaging in fights to save HP).

But, to make smart decisions, you must first explore and learn the world. This means you will need to save and restore often, which the game openly encourages.

[h1]Difficulty[/h1]
The game is easy to start but very difficult to complete, especially if going for the secret/true endings (though perhaps not as difficult as some other titles in the DROD series). Luckily, there is lots of spoiler-free tips from fellow players available on the community forums at http://forum.caravelgames.com/. Also, the second, harder half of the game has a secret option to make the game somewhat easier at the cost of scores and achievements. This might be a good choice for initial exploration.

[h1]Ambiance[/h1]
The gameplay experience is further enhanced by an excellent soundtrack and an entertaining story that ties into the greater lore of the DROD world. It's absolutely not necessary to have played previous DROD games to appreciate Tendry's Tale, but it does help to understand some of the references.

[h1]Value[/h1]
If you finish the game and still want more, you can play the many community made "holds".

So, I highly recommend Tendry's Tale to puzzle enthusiasts (although I recommend the main DROD series even more highly!). I've bought most of the DROD games at their original full price of $20 with absolutely no regrets.
